data.one_liner: Build customized TabBar indicators using familiar Container-like properties.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ContainerTabIndicator decoration class for Flutter's TabBar widget. Allows manipulation of width, height, color, radius, border, and positioning within a tab.
use_when: You need a custom TabBar indicator with specific dimensions, borders, or padding
You want to style tab indicators using familiar Container-like properties
avoid_when: You need standard Material design tab indicators
You require complex animations not supported by the basic decoration properties
strengths: Easy to customize with width, height, radius, and border properties
Familiar API similar to the standard Container widget
weaknesses: Package is still in early stages according to documentation
data.minimal_example:
TabBar(
  tabs: [
    Text('First', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.black)),
    Text('Second', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.black)),
  ],
  indicator: ContainerTabIndicator(
    width: 16,
    height: 16,
    radius: BorderRadius.circular(8.0),
    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 36),
    borderWidth: 2.0,
    borderColor: Colors.black,
  ),
)
